## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Traceability

## Validation

List exact commands and results. Mark checks unavailable in the current phase
as unavailable with a reason; do not report them as passing.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and follows CONTRIBUTING.md.
- [ ] Feature dependencies, ORM-only access and money/date conventions are followed.
- [ ] Required Javadoc, Google-style docstrings and LuaDoc are included where applicable.
- [ ] Unit tests cover changed behavior, boundaries and relevant error codes.
- [ ] Available lint, format and test checks pass.
- [ ] Both affected backend coverage gates meet 80%; gateway coverage is reported where applicable.
- [ ] Documentation, environment examples and changelog are updated where needed.
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, dumps or generated artifacts are included.
- [ ] Any unavailable checks or non-applicable checklist items are explained below.

## Limitations / non-applicable items

Include current-phase tooling limitations and any follow-up work.
